description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractMessageCommand' for message-related command classes in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common functionality such as payload serialization, validation of thing IDs, and message handling, to be extended by concrete command implementations.

classes.name: AbstractMessageCommand
classes.description: An abstract base class for message commands parameterized with payload and command type, providing common validation, serialization, and equality logic.

methods.name: AbstractMessageCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing command type, thing ID, message, and headers, with validation.

methods.name: validateThingId
methods.description: Validates that the thing ID from the message matches the expected thing ID, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with the command.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the Message payload associated with this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload, headers, and message into a JSON object builder.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a Message object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on superclass, thing ID, and message.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering class, thing ID, message, and superclass properties.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Determines if the other object is an instance of AbstractMessageCommand.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including superclass info, thing ID, and message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for setting DittoHeaders.
